source_summary: Monochrome ink-and-wash Chinese winter landscape with towering cliffs, mist bands, snow-covered paths, pavilions, village roofs, pine groves, rocky ravines, bridges, water, and small human/animal figures. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded from the motif bank.

motifs.name: towering_left_cliff_massif
motifs.description: Isolate the monumental pale cliff formation rising on the left and center-left: sheer vertical rock faces, rounded snowy tops, dark fissures, inner crags, and soft mist at the base. Exclude the lower pavilion compound and foreground village.
must_preserve: thin dark contour lines around cliff silhouettes
vertical ink-wash streaks suggesting height and erosion
dark cracked interior rock seams
soft pale snow reserves on rounded tops
mist-softened lower edges

motifs.name: upper_cliff_pavilion_bridge
motifs.description: Isolate the small pavilion and terrace complex perched between cliffs near the upper center, including the narrow bridge-like walkway, layered tiled roofs, railings, adjacent rock ledges, and clustered pines around it.
must_preserve: precise roof geometry with stacked eaves
fine railing and bridge linework
dark pine foliage dots and needle clusters
small supporting cliff ledges
contrast between crisp architecture and misty cliff wash

motifs.name: lower_left_mountain_temple
motifs.description: Isolate the snow-covered temple or pavilion compound on the mid-left hillside with tiered roofs, a small tower-like structure, surrounding trees, and the sloping snow bank beneath it.
must_preserve: curved tiled roof edges and layered eaves
delicate architectural posts and railings
small vertical tower roof detail
dense dark tree crowns behind the buildings
smooth snow slope contour below

motifs.name: foreground_snow_village
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-left village cluster: snow-laden houses, fenced yards, small figures, courtyard details, gates, bare and evergreen trees, and the descending path at the lower edge.
must_preserve: angular snow-covered roof planes
fine fence and gate linework
tiny human figures and courtyard objects
dark branching tree silhouettes over roofs
stepped path strokes descending into the foreground

motifs.name: central_rocky_ravine
motifs.description: Isolate the central foreground ravine and snow-covered rock mass: jagged cliffs, dark crevices, winding path-like snow reserves, shrub clumps, and vertical wash textures. Exclude the village to the left and bridge scene to the right.
must_preserve: jagged ink outlines along broken rock edges
layered texture strokes on exposed stone
soft snow reserves crossing the rocks
dark shrub clusters tucked into crevices
vertical wash streaks on the pale cliff face

motifs.name: right_stream_bridge_scene
motifs.description: Isolate the mid-right stream crossing with wooden bridge structures, railings, travelers or attendants, a horse or pack animal, stepping stones, shallow water marks, and tall pines lining the bank.
must_preserve: thin wooden bridge posts and railings
tiny figures and animal silhouettes
scattered white stone shapes in the water
vertical pine trunks with dark clustered crowns
subtle water wash and rippled ink marks

motifs.name: right_snowy_hillside_cliffs
motifs.description: Isolate the snow-covered rocky hills and cliffs on the right side above the stream, including rounded snow caps, exposed dark ledges, sparse shrubs, and layered receding forms. Exclude the bridge scene below and calligraphy above.
must_preserve: rounded snow-covered hill silhouettes
dark angular rock ledge texture
pale receding hill layers in mist
small shrub and tree accents
soft wash transitions along valley edges

motifs.name: lower_right_river_cove_trees
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-right water cove with overhanging dark trees, small figures near the bank, scattered stones, low snowy rocks, and soft river wash fading into mist.
must_preserve: dense dark branching canopy over the water
tiny bank-side figures and poles
scattered stone highlights in the river
smooth gray-brown water wash
snowy rock contours along the shoreline

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
